name: @skew-trade/sdk
description: Skew RFQ's TypeScript SDK. "." is the app SDK: a user's held orders (planned from the book's terms, signed by an injected agent signer, placed, cancelled, read and followed), the public markets feed and Hyperliquid's L1 signing. "./maker" is the maker SDK: firm held orders signed, replaced and withdrawn per book, listed, and the event feed followed.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/esm-specifiers.mjs dist
